sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The model deeds listed below can be used as a basis for a deed of settlement

1. Full model deed (DOCX, 43.9 KB)This link will download a file – Used for a complex income tax dispute
2. Short model deed (DOCX, 37.0 KB)This link will download a file – Used for a less complex income tax dispute
3. GST model deed (DOC, 120 KB)This link will download a file – Used for a GST dispute
4. Short deed for ART cases (DOCX, 41.3 KB)This link will download a file – Used for an income tax dispute that is currently with the Administrative Review Tribunal

| **Find out more** |
